in_sanskrit.name: शरवतीश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्वती (Sharvati) - Goddess of Love; ईश (Ish) - God; शर्वतीश (Sharvateesh) - God of Love

in_hindi.name: शरवतीश
in_hindi.long_meaning: शर्वती (Sharvati) - प्रेम (Prem) का देव (Dev) ; शर्वतीश (Sharvateesh) - प्रेमकार (Premkar) - God of Love

in_tamil.name: ஷரவாதீஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஷர்வதி (Sharvati) - அங்குரியன் (Angkuriyan) - இலக்கியம் (Ilakkiyam) - ஜனனியம் (Jananiyam) - ஷர்வதீஷ (Sharvateesh) - அங்குரியன் இலக்கியம் (Angkuriyan Ilakkiyam) - God of Love

in_telugu.name: శర్వటీష
in_telugu.long_meaning: శర్వటీ (Sharvatee) - ప్రేమ (Prema) - దేశ (Desh) - శర్వటీష (Sharvateesh) - ప్రేమదేశ (Prema Desh) - God of Love

in_marathi.name: Sharwateesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwateesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharwateesh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words - Sharwa (God of Prosperity) and Ish (God). It is believed that this name brings abundance, wealth and prosperity to the person bearing it.
